title: "LIFE'S FUNDAMENTAL PROPERTIES"

lists.name: LIFE'S FUNDAMENTAL PROPERTIES
items: ONTOGENESIS (incl. growth, morphogenesis, and functional development).
HOMEOSTASIS and (progressive) INDEPENDENCE OF THE ENVIRONMENT and 'destructive contingencies' (active and cybernetic maintenance of some 'optimal' internal or external state or process).
REPRODUCTION, spatial PROPAGATION, diachronic propagation, and PROLIFERATION.
Systematic and active MOVEMENT [locomotion, external manipulation, intrabodily movement, and/or internal transport].
AGING and DEATH (of bionts, species, and higher taxa).

ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING [environments': creation, modification, adaptation, control, maintenance, repair, evolution, monitoring, spatial differentiation, temporal differentiation, coordination, improvement, industrialization, etc].
ITERATION [cf. #6 as a special case of iteration].
[perpetual, systematic, progressive, and arborescent] VARIATION, INNOVATION, and perhaps SELF-TRANSFORMATION.
ARBORESCENCE [morphological, dynamical, developmental, evolutionary, and more abstract types of arborescence].

RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT AND MANAGEMENT (incl. [acquisition, 'universal incorporation' transformation, storage, shipment, creation, development, concentration, purification, protection, diversification, etc] of [energy, material, spatial, biological, temporal, chemical, geological, atmospheric, and other] resources and capacities).
ANTISYZYGIATISM (meeting of opposites in or through).

notes: by Patrick Gunkel. Handwritten at upper left: "→ SEE OBVERSE NOTES!" The photographed list continues below the frame; subsequent items are omitted.
